name: Bad Elster (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically yellow and black, charged at the top with the city arms of Bad Elster (a magpie on a green mount on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Bad Elster; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Bad Elster arms — magpie on green mount on yellow
